body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0012 {
  meta:
    author = "Threat Detection Engineering"
    description = "Registry Run key persistence (Sysmon 13) - Detects registry value sets in common Run/RunOnce persistence keys via Sysmon Event ID 13. Tune allowlists for known software updaters and enterprise tooling."
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0012"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1547.001"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION" or $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION")
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "13"
    ($e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\run(once)?\\/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\policies\\explorer\\run\\/ nocase)
    $name = $e.principal.hostname
    $name_ = $e.principal.user.userid
    $key = $e.target.registry.registry_key

  match:
    $name, $name_, $key over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $images = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $value_data = array_distinct($e.target.registry.registry_value_data)

  condition:
    $e
}
